content:
Dear Neighbor,

Here’s a quick guide for the vegetable patch this week in July. Water in the morning, especially for tomatoes, beans, and lettuce—keep the soil moist but not soggy. Weed gently around the rows and add a little mulch to keep the heat off the roots. Check leaves for aphids or slugs and pick off any ripe vegetables; don’t leave overripe fruit on the plants. If the weather is very hot, give the patch a little shade or a light sprinkling of water in the afternoon.

Thanks for helping out—I’ll be glad to swap tips when you’re done.

Best wishes,  
Your Gardener
